content: 'Encryption at rest' on a server the app itself controls the keys for is not a strong guarantee — if the host/DB is compromised, the same process that decrypts for legitimate use decrypts for the attacker; genuine protection requires either end-to-end encryption where the server never holds the key, or a local-only architecture. Journal content covering emotional/mental-health topics qualifies as sensitive health-category data under frameworks like GDPR, implying a materially higher bar than ordinary app data — relevant when a psychological profile is derived and stored server-side alongside encrypted API keys in the same DB file.
